:rotating_light::gb:*<https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/aisi/jobs/4963394101| UK AISI's Control Red Team is hiring Researchers to evaluate labs' control monitors (London)>* :gb::rotating_light:
I think this is an extremely impactful role, and the value of third parties has never been clearer. See Charlie's tweet <https://x.com/c_j_griffin/status/2095914734289883157|thread> but some takes:
1. Somebody needs to be able to answer: "if we deployed this model, under that monitor, what is the risk the model would cause a catastrophe before it was caught?" Even better if they are a 3rd party, and even better if they're a democratic government. Right now, I don't think the science of control is ready to make confident assessments - but we are trying to fix that!
2. Second, the team is an excellent spot to run those control evals. We sit inside AISI's (imo extremely talent dense) Red Team which has existing lab relationships and two years of experience breaking their alignment and misuse safeguards - with experiments often featuring in system cards (e.g. <https://x.com/_robertkirk/status/2095615154490843155|Astra>). <https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/how-our-new-control-red-team-is-stress-testing-frontier-monitors|This year we've already evaluated (and beaten) monitors from Anthropic and GDM.> We've got serious automated red-teaming, an excellent infra team, and unmatched model access. 
The control sub-team itself is currently just two people! We're looking to make two additional hires, who will have a tonne of leverage to help our evals. Please take a look at the application, or reach out to Charlie Griffin or me if you have any questions!

Guess what?  Our friends at AE Studio are hiring for a research engineer role (and Jonathan Michala is now an RM there!):
> <https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/aestudio/jobs/6009528004|Alignment Scientist/Engineer>
> Fully Remote; LA office / US remote

> CaML is now hiring two research engineers for our new research project on alignment midtraining (i.e. Synthetic Document FInetuning for values, like "Teaching Claude Why"). This could offer a way of instilling values without the issues with RL but sometimes is erased by subsequent fine-tuning. We suspect the deciding factor is whether the AI believes before RL that the behavior is reinforced by RL, and we seek to test this thoroughly. Pay would be $110k, remote with Berkeley preferred.  
Email: <mailto:hello@compassionml.com|hello@compassionml.com> to express interest and learn more.

*Successif is hiring for an Advisor, Biosecurity*

Impact of the role:
Successif helps mid-career and senior professionals transition into work on global catastrophic risks. The Biosecurity Advisor will lead our advising for people moving into biosecurity: regular 1:1 advising sessions, reviewing application materials and research proposals, and building networks with biosecurity organisations to surface hiring opportunities for advisees. This person's role will be to offer strategic guidance, practical support, and personal empowerment throughout their career transition journey.

What we're looking for:
• Strong communication skills and emotional awareness, with advising, coaching, or consulting experience a plus
• Commitment to addressing global catastrophic risks
• Someone who has been through a career transition themselves is a strong plus

The role is remote (most countries), part-time or full-time, starting November 2026. Full description: <https://www.successif.org/biosecurity-advisor|successif.org/biosecurity-advisor>

:wave: Apollo Research is hiring for 9 different roles across Watcher product engineering, security & control research, and our internal security team.

<https://watcher.apolloresearch.ai/landing/|Watcher>, our coding agent security product, is deployed in production and monitors billions of agent tokens per month at agent-building scale-ups and multinational enterprises. We define what those controls are and red-team frontier monitors (e.g. against Anthropic's auto-mode). Our own team runs around 400 billion tokens a month, which makes us both a target and a testbed for the defences we’re building.

Every role is open in both our London :gb: and San Francisco :us: offices. We offer market competitive salaries, equity, and competitive benefits. Our staff effectively have an unlimited token budget. A formal AI safety background is explicitly not required for the security and product roles.

Apply now! Links to roles in :thread:

Hi! I'm the co-founder of Guidelight; you might have seen our <https://x.com/sjgadler/status/2089828449049522664?s=20|recent assessment> of companies' Control practices, or <https://thezvi.substack.com/p/frontier-lab-employee-open-letter|Pacing the Frontier>, which we organized (together with Encode)

We might be looking to bring someone on in the next 2-3 weeks to work on our alignment assessment, for our forthcoming alignment standard

*If you might be interested in starting a role that quickly, could you please DM me with a short blurb on your background?*

Without getting too into the weeds, we have good evidence that these assessments change companies' & governments' orientation to mitigations, and we now want to expand that to other important areas, like alignment, RSI-management, etc.

(I'd also love if you could share a piece of work you're proud of, though that can come after the initial DM. For instance, is there something where you brought conceptual clarity to a messy space of ideas? Is there work where you both did strong synthesis and also attention-to-detail?)

Thank you!
